name: Follistatin
description: Protein the body makes that binds myostatin and activin; tested in people only as gene therapy

note.text: Published trials treated 12 people with muscle disease, without placebo groups. The protein itself has no published trial.

bullets: **Binds and blocks** myostatin, a signal that limits muscle growth, and activin
**Can lower FSH** through the pituitary’s activin–inhibin system
**Gene delivery** (AAV or plasmid) makes the body produce the protein
**Muscle gains** shown in monkeys; in people, data are from 12 patients
Newer plasmid and AAV trials unpublished

practical.routes: Gene therapy injected into muscle (AAV or plasmid)
practical.soldAs: Promoted online in compounded combo products (FDA)

regulatory.text: Not approved, as a protein or gene therapy

references: Mol Ther, AAV1 follistatin gene therapy in Becker muscular dystrophy, Jan 2015
FDA, briefing document on KPV, PCAC meeting, May 2026
